set.audit.exportHint: Exports all entries matching the current filters (max. 10,000).
set.audit.loadError: Could not load the audit log: {{message}}
set.audit.retentionConfirm: Entries older than {{days}} days will be permanently deleted on the next run. Continue?
set.audit.retentionHelp: 0 = keep forever. Allowed: 7 to 3650 days. Older entries are deleted hourly in the background – this also removes the record history and the ability to roll those changes back.
set.audit.retentionInvalid: Please enter 0 or a value between 7 and 3650.
set.audit.retentionWorkerOff: The background worker is disabled – nothing is deleted automatically.
set.audit.usersUnavailable: Could not load the user list
set.history.beforeRecreateHint: This entry dates from before the zone was permanently deleted and re-created. Only administrators can see it; it cannot be rolled back.
set.history.blocked.legacy_format: Recorded before 3.0 – cannot be rolled back
set.history.blocked.only_excluded_records: Only SOA, DNSSEC or ACME records
set.history.blocked.zone_recreated: Zone was deleted and re-created afterwards
set.history.computedAfterNote: The resulting state was computed because the server could not be read afterwards.
set.history.empty: No changes have been recorded for this zone yet.
set.history.filterSearchPlaceholder: Name or content, e.g. www or 192.0.2.1
set.history.forcedNote: Forced despite changes made in the meantime.
set.history.incompleteNote: The previous state could not be fully captured.
set.history.legacyEntry: Entry from a version before 3.0 – the previous state was not fully recorded.
set.history.outcome.failed: The change failed on the primary.
set.history.outcome.unknown: It could not be determined whether the change reached the primary. Please check the current state.
set.history.outcome.verified_after_timeout: The primary did not answer in time; the change was confirmed afterwards by reading it back.
set.history.rollbackAlreadyReverted: This change was already rolled back by #{{id}}.
set.history.rollbackConflictBody: For {{count}} RRset(s) the current state no longer matches the state right after this change. Rolling back overwrites these newer changes.
set.history.rollbackConflictReloaded: The zone was changed in the meantime. The preview has been reloaded – please review it again.
set.history.rollbackForce: I have reviewed the differences – roll back anyway
set.history.rollbackIntro: These RRsets will be set back to their state before the change – on {{server}} and all other writable servers.
set.history.rollbackNothing: Nothing to do – the records are already in the state before the change.
set.history.rollbackPartial: Rolled back, but failed on these servers: {{servers}}
set.history.rollbackServerHint: The change was written via {{source}}, the rollback runs via {{server}}.
set.history.skipReason.acme_challenge: ACME challenge – managed by the certificate client
set.history.skipReason.dnssec: DNSSEC record – change it via DNSSEC management
set.history.subtitle: All recorded changes to this zone – regardless of which server they were made through.
set.history.title: Change history
set.history.truncatedNote: Too many changes for the log ({{total}} RRsets) – only the affected names were stored.
set.zoneDetail.recordHistoryTitle: Show the history of this record
